semantic_atoms.observed: WorldExperience maintains entities, typed CausalLinks, high-fidelity Fingerprints, telemetry and anatomy-version metadata in world_experience.db. CausalLink carries relation_type, Bayesian-style confidence, weight, observation_count, timestamps, anatomy_hash and status.

Fingerprint retention is tiered: recent raw vectors, older dense 4-bit quantized vectors, then sparse records with vectors stripped; capacity pressure can trigger purge. The mechanism is explicitly lossy and storage-oriented.

The QUBO layer maps Frank state into a fixed 39-variable schema with one-hot groups and hand-coded logical couplings, then adds state-dependent terms. FrankState contains E-PQ, phase/mode/intent, mood, goals, surprise, confidence and reflector/AURA fields.

The inspected builder reads latest rows from separate historical databases such as world_experience.db and consciousness.db in separate operations. No single atomic causal frame, generation binding or shared admission identity is established by those reads.

A stored relation named triggers/inhibits/modulates/correlates plus Bayesian-style confidence does not establish intervention-level causality by itself. Observation repetition can strengthen a candidate link but cannot promote it to canonical world fact without effect/outcome evidence.

preserve: observation count and confidence update history
change: Move observations, causal hypotheses and evidence references into UnifiedDB typed canonical tables; world_experience.db must not survive as a second truth authority.
Build each world-model/QUBO input from one immutable CausalWorkspaceFrame with frame_id, generation, causal_event_ids, admission_ids and source digests instead of cross-database latest-row reads.
Classify CausalLinks as hypotheses with evidence level OBSERVATIONAL or INTERVENTIONAL. Only admitted EffectJournal outcome re-entry can supply intervention evidence.
QUBO/annealing/coherence results are WorldModelCandidate projections. They may rank or propose state interpretations but never mint facts, capabilities, effects or completion.

Lossy raw->dense->sparse erosion may apply only after durable source/digest/provenance retention and policy eligibility. Protected negative results, causal receipts, authority history and effect evidence are non-erodible.
Bind every derived sparse fingerprint to its preserved source-set digest so reduced storage cannot sever reproducibility.
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.recommended_flow: Typed Entry -> CausalWorkspaceFrame -> WorldExperience observational hypotheses -> bounded WorldModel/QUBO candidate fusion -> GRID/GWT deliberation -> ActionCandidate -> EffectGate -> EffectJournal -> verified outcome re-entry -> optional causal-hypothesis update

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Replacing multi-DB latest reads with immutable frame-bound fusion will improve deterministic replay and eliminate impossible mixed-time QUBO states.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: A concurrency stress test proves the current separate latest-row reads always correspond to one shared causal generation under writer races.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: WorldExperience's fidelity tiers are reusable only if evidence identity survives the lossy transform.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Exact reconstruction tests show sparse historical records without preserved source digests still reproduce all architecture-relevant causal claims and contradictions.

triggerword4_handoff.instruction: Feed GRID10 a frame-bound world-model projection, not live reads from several mutable DBs. Preserve WorldExperience causal hypotheses and QUBO constraint machinery as candidate cognition; bind intervention updates to EffectJournal outcome evidence.
